narrative.headline: The Canadiens are the team on the rise
narrative.blurb: 47 games on this week's slate. The Hurricanes are No. 1 at 11-2-2 with a +20 goal differential. The East's last playoff spot is the Maple Leafs on 16 points. The West's last spot is the Sharks on 15 points. The Canadiens lead the heat check at 3-0-0 and +6 goals over the last three games.
